plugin.name: many-ai
plugin.description: Transcribes the quoted audio using Whisper (Groq).

noReply: Reply to an audio with !transcrever for me to transcribe it.
missingKey: My Groq API key isn't configured. Ask the bot admin to set GROQ_API_KEY in ~/.manybot/manybot.toml.
trimFailed: That audio is too large ({{sizeMb}}MB, {{limitMb}}MB limit) and I couldn't trim it.
groupLimited: This group already hit its limit of {{limit}} transcriptions today. Try again in {{timeLeft}}.
senderLimited: You already hit your limit of {{limit}} transcriptions today. Try again in {{timeLeft}}.
